/* (조기)취업자 명단 */ SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY G.TRPR_INFO_NO ORDER BY H.MNG_SN DESC ) ROW_NO , A.BIZ_YR AS BIZ_YR /*사업연도*/ , D.INST_NO AS INST_NO /*기관번호*/ , D.INST_NM AS INST_NM /*기관명*/ , C.RESRCE_NO AS RESRCE_NO /*자원번호*/ , C.PVSN_RESRCE_NM AS PVSN_RESRCE_NM /*제공자원명*/ , E.CASE_MNG_NO AS CASE_MNG_NO /*사례관리번호*/ , E.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AS CASE_MNG_ODRNO /*사례관리차수*/ , G.TRPR_INFO_NO AS TRPR_INFO_NO /*대상자정보번호*/ , DEC_B64(G.TRPR_NM_ENCPT) AS TRPR_NM /*대상자명암호화*/ , G.TRPR_BRTH_YMD AS TRPR_BRTH_YMD /*대상자출생일자*/ , H.EMPYMN_ERA_SE_CD AS EMPYMN /*취업시기 구분코드*/ , H.MNG_SN AS MNG_SN /*관리일련번호*/ , H.CO_NM AS CO_NM /*회사명*/ , H.SGG_CD AS SGG_CD /*시군구코드*/ , (SELECT CTPV_NM FROM SAA020 WHERE SGG_CD = H.SGG_CD) AS SGG_CD_NM1 /*시군구코드1*/ , (SELECT SGG_NM FROM SAA020 WHERE SGG_CD = H.SGG_CD) AS SGG_CD_NM2 /*시군구코드2*/ , H.TKCG_TASKWK_CN AS TKCG_TASKWK_CN /*담당업무*/ , H.SALARY_AMT AS SALARY_AMT /*급여금액*/ , H.RM_CN AS RM_CN /*비고내용*/ , H.ATFINO AS ATFINO /*첨부파일번호*/ , CASE WHEN LENGTH(K.REAL_FILE_NM) > 8 THEN SUBSTR(K.REAL_FILE_NM, 0, 10) || '..' ELSE K.REAL_FILE_NM END AS REAL_FILE_NM /*실제파일이름 */ , K.REAL_FILE_NM AS REAL_FILE_TIP /*실제파일이름툴팁*/ , I.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS TRMN /*종결사유구분코드 IN 042, 044, 047, 054*/ , I.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS TRMNNM FROM SDA400 A /*서비스사업*/ JOIN SDA420 B /*서비스실행사업*/ ON A.SRVC_BIZ_NO = B.SRVC_BIZ_NO JOIN SDA100 C /*자원기본*/ ON B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = C.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO JOIN SAA000 D /*통합기관*/ ON C.RSFR_INST_NO = D.INST_NO LEFT JOIN SEB510 E /*서비스제공대상자*/ ON C.RESRCE_NO = E.RESRCE_NO LEFT JOIN SEB100 L /*사례기본*/ ON E.CASE_MNG_NO = L.CASE_MNG_NO AND E.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = L.CASE_MNG_ODRNO LEFT JOIN (SELECT BB.CASE_MNG_NO, BB.CASE_MNG_ODRNO, BB.TRMN_CS_SE_CD, AA.CASE_TRMN_YMD, BB.TRMN_SE_CD, BB.YNGBGS_CHNG_LAST_RESULT_CN, AA.PIC_OPNN_CN ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY BB.CASE_MNG_NO, BB.CASE_MNG_ODRNO ORDER BY BB.CASE_TRMN_NO DESC) AS RN FROM SEC100 AA /*사례종결 테이블*/ LEFT JOIN SEC100 BB ON BB.CASE_MNG_NO = AA.CASE_MNG_NO AND BB.CASE_MNG_NO = AA.CASE_MNG_NO AND BB.TRMN_SRNG_RESULT_SE_CD = '01' /*종결심사결과구분코드(신청)*/ WHERE AA.TRMN_SRNG_RESULT_SE_CD = '02' /*종결심사결과구분코드(심사(승인))*/ )F ON F.CASE_MNG_NO = E.CASE_MNG_NO AND F.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = E.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND F.RN=1 LEFT JOIN SEA200 G /*대상자정보*/ ON G.TRPR_INFO_NO = L.TRPR_INFO_NO LEFT JOIN SEA250 H /*취업정보*/ ON G.TRPR_INFO_NO = H.TRPR_INFO_NO LEFT JOIN SAC100 I /*종결사유구분코드*/ ON I.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'TRMN_CS_SE_CD' AND I.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = F.TRMN_CS_SE_CD LEFT JOIN SAB820 J ON J.ATFINO = H.ATFINO LEFT JOIN SAB821 K ON K.ATFINO = J.ATFINO AND K.ATFINO = H.ATFINO
WHERE F.TRMN_CS_SE_CD IN ('042', '044', '047', '054') AND H.DEL_YN = 'N' AND D.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} AND A.BIZ_YR LIKE #{BIZ_YR} || '%' AND D.INST_NO LIKE #{INST_NO} || '%' AND C.RESRCE_NO LIKE #{RESRCE_NO} || '%'
AND G.TRPR_NM_ENCPT = ENC_B64(#{TRPR_NM})
AND C.SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_CD <> '01' AND C.APRV_STTS_SE_CD = '2' ) A WHERE ROW_NO = 1

/* 중도탈락자 명단 */ SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY G.TRPR_INFO_NO ORDER BY H.MNG_SN DESC ) ROW_NO , A.BIZ_YR AS BIZ_YR /*사업연도*/ , D.INST_NO AS INST_NO /*기관번호*/ , D.INST_NM AS INST_NM /*기관명*/ , C.RESRCE_NO AS RESRCE_NO /*자원번호*/ , C.PVSN_RESRCE_NM AS PVSN_RESRCE_NM /*제공자원명*/ , E.CASE_MNG_NO AS CASE_MNG_NO /*사례관리번호*/ , E.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AS CASE_MNG_ODRNO /*사례관리차수*/ , G.TRPR_INFO_NO AS TRPR_INFO_NO /*대상자정보번호*/ , DEC_B64(G.TRPR_NM_ENCPT) AS TRPR_NM /*대상자명암호화*/ , G.TRPR_BRTH_YMD AS TRPR_BRTH_YMD /*대상자출생일자*/ , H.EMPYMN_ERA_SE_CD AS EMPYMN /*취업시기 구분코드*/ , H.CO_NM AS CO_NM /*회사명*/ , H.SGG_CD AS SGG_CD /*소재지*/ , (SELECT CTPV_NM FROM SAA020 WHERE SGG_CD = H.SGG_CD) AS SGG_CD_NM1 /*시군구코드1*/ , (SELECT SGG_NM FROM SAA020 WHERE SGG_CD = H.SGG_CD) AS SGG_CD_NM2 /*시군구코드2*/ , H.TKCG_TASKWK_CN AS TKCG_TASKWK_CN /*담당업무*/ , H.SALARY_AMT AS SALARY_AMT /*급여금액*/ , H.RM_CN AS RM_CN /*비고*/ , CASE -- 자격증취득여부 1 TRUE WHEN C.PVSN_BGNG_YMD < J.ACQS_YMD THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS QLFC , I.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS TRMNNM , L.CASE_TRMN_YMD AS CASE_TRMN_YMD /*사례종결일자*/
FROM SDA400 A /*서비스사업*/ JOIN SDA420 B /*서비스실행사업*/ ON A.SRVC_BIZ_NO = B.SRVC_BIZ_NO JOIN SDA100 C /*자원기본*/ ON B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = C.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO JOIN SAA000 D /*통합기관*/ ON C.RSFR_INST_NO = D.INST_NO JOIN SEB510 E /*서비스제공대상자*/ ON C.RESRCE_NO = E.RESRCE_NO LEFT JOIN SEB100 L /*사례기본*/ ON E.CASE_MNG_NO = L.CASE_MNG_NO AND E.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = L.CASE_MNG_ODRNO LEFT JOIN (SELECT BB.CASE_MNG_NO, BB.CASE_MNG_ODRNO, BB.TRMN_CS_SE_CD, AA.CASE_TRMN_YMD, BB.TRMN_SE_CD, BB.YNGBGS_CHNG_LAST_RESULT_CN, AA.PIC_OPNN_CN ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY BB.CASE_MNG_NO, BB.CASE_MNG_ODRNO ORDER BY BB.CASE_TRMN_NO DESC) AS RN FROM SEC100 AA /*사례종결 테이블*/ LEFT JOIN SEC100 BB ON BB.CASE_MNG_NO = AA.CASE_MNG_NO AND BB.CASE_MNG_NO = AA.CASE_MNG_NO AND BB.TRMN_SRNG_RESULT_SE_CD = '01' /*종결심사결과구분코드(신청)*/ WHERE AA.TRMN_SRNG_RESULT_SE_CD = '02' /*종결심사결과구분코드(심사(승인))*/ )F ON F.CASE_MNG_NO = E.CASE_MNG_NO AND F.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = E.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND F.RN=1 LEFT JOIN SEA200 G /*대상자정보*/ ON G.TRPR_INFO_NO = L.TRPR_INFO_NO LEFT JOIN SEA250 H /*취업정보*/ ON G.TRPR_INFO_NO = H.TRPR_INFO_NO LEFT JOIN SAC100 I /*종결사유구분코드*/ ON I.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'TRMN_CS_SE_CD' AND I.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = F.TRMN_CS_SE_CD LEFT JOIN SEA260 J /*자격증취득여부*/ ON G.TRPR_INFO_NO = J.TRPR_INFO_NO
WHERE D.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} AND F.TRMN_CS_SE_CD IN ('049', '050', '051', '052', '053', '054' , '055', '056') AND NVL(H.DEL_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND A.BIZ_YR LIKE #{BIZ_YR} || '%' AND D.INST_NO LIKE #{INST_NO} || '%' AND C.RESRCE_NO LIKE #{RESRCE_NO} || '%'
AND G.TRPR_NM_ENCPT = ENC_B64(#{TRPR_NM})
AND C.SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_CD <> '01' AND C.APRV_STTS_SE_CD = '2' ) A WHERE ROW_NO = 1

/* 자격증취득자 명단 */ SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY G.TRPR_INFO_NO ORDER BY G.TRPR_INFO_NO DESC) ROW_NO , BIZ_YR AS BIZ_YR /*사업연도*/ , D.INST_NO AS INST_NO /*기관번호*/ , D.INST_NM AS INST_NM /*기관명*/ , C.RESRCE_NO AS RESRCE_NO /*자원번호*/ , C.PVSN_RESRCE_NM AS PVSN_RESRCE_NM /*제공자원명*/ , E.CASE_MNG_NO AS CASE_MNG_NO /*사례관리번호*/ , E.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AS CASE_MNG_ODRNO /*사례관리차수*/ , CASE WHEN F.CASE_TRMN_YMD IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(F.CASE_TRMN_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') END AS TRMN_YMD /*사례종결일자*/ , G.TRPR_INFO_NO AS TRPR_INFO_NO /*대상자정보번호*/ , DEC_B64(G.TRPR_NM_ENCPT) AS TRPR_NM /*대상자명암호화*/ , G.TRPR_BRTH_YMD AS TRPR_BRTH_YMD /*대상자출생일자*/ , H.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS TRMN_CD , H.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS TRMN , J.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS MDSTRM_CD , J.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS MDSTRM , (SELECT LISTAGG(CERTI_NM, ', ') WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY CERTI_NM) FROM SEA260 WHERE C.PVSN_BGNG_YMD < ACQS_YMD AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND TRPR_INFO_NO = G.TRPR_INFO_NO) AS CERTI_NM /*자격증명*/ FROM SDA400 A JOIN SDA420 B ON A.SRVC_BIZ_NO = B.SRVC_BIZ_NO JOIN SDA100 C ON B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = C.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO JOIN SAA000 D ON C.RSFR_INST_NO = D.INST_NO LEFT JOIN SEB510 E ON C.RESRCE_NO = E.RESRCE_NO LEFT JOIN SEB100 L ON E.CASE_MNG_NO = L.CASE_MNG_NO AND E.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = L.CASE_MNG_ODRNO LEFT JOIN (SELECT BB.CASE_MNG_NO, BB.CASE_MNG_ODRNO, BB.TRMN_CS_SE_CD, AA.CASE_TRMN_YMD, BB.TRMN_SE_CD, BB.YNGBGS_CHNG_LAST_RESULT_CN, AA.PIC_OPNN_CN ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY BB.CASE_MNG_NO, BB.CASE_MNG_ODRNO ORDER BY BB.CASE_TRMN_NO DESC) AS RN FROM SEC100 AA /*사례종결 테이블*/ LEFT JOIN SEC100 BB ON BB.CASE_MNG_NO = AA.CASE_MNG_NO AND BB.CASE_MNG_NO = AA.CASE_MNG_NO AND BB.TRMN_SRNG_RESULT_SE_CD = '01' /*종결심사결과구분코드(신청)*/ WHERE AA.TRMN_SRNG_RESULT_SE_CD = '02' /*종결심사결과구분코드(심사(승인))*/ )F ON F.CASE_MNG_NO = E.CASE_MNG_NO AND F.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = E.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND F.RN=1 LEFT JOIN SEA200 G ON G.TRPR_INFO_NO = L.TRPR_INFO_NO JOIN SEA260 T ON G.TRPR_INFO_NO = T.TRPR_INFO_NO LEFT JOIN SAC100 H ON H.CMMNS_CD_ID ='TRMN_CS_SE_CD' AND H.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = F.TRMN_CS_SE_CD LEFT JOIN SAC100 J ON J.CMMNS_CD_ID ='TRMN_CS_SE_CD' AND J.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = F.TRMN_CS_SE_CD AND F.TRMN_CS_SE_CD IN ('049', '050', '051', '052', '053', '054', '056')
WHERE 1=1 /* 20230807 20230807 종결여부와 상관없이 자격증 취득 성과가 등록된 대상자 조회 */ AND (T.OUTC_SE_CD = '2' OR F.TRMN_CS_SE_CD IN ('042', '043', '044', '045', '046', '047', '048', '049', '050', '051', '052', '053', '054', '055', '056')) AND C.PVSN_BGNG_YMD < T.ACQS_YMD AND D.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} AND A.BIZ_YR LIKE #{BIZ_YR} || '%' AND D.INST_NO LIKE #{INST_NO} || '%' AND C.RESRCE_NO LIKE #{RESRCE_NO} || '%'
AND G.TRPR_NM_ENCPT = ENC_B64(#{TRPR_NM})
AND C.SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_CD <> '01' AND C.APRV_STTS_SE_CD = '2' ) A WHERE ROW_NO = 1 AND CERTI_NM IS NOT NULL

/* 상세 - 교육과정정보*/ SELECT COUNT(A.RESRCE_NO) AS RESRCE , A.PVSN_RESRCE_NM AS RESRCE_NM , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.PVSN_BGNG_YMD), 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS BGNG_YMD , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.PVSN_END_YMD), 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS END_YMD , A.PTCPTN_NOPE AS PTCPTN_NOPE , A.UTZTN_PSNCPA_NOPE AS UTZTN_PSNCPA ,SUM(D.PROGRM_SUM_HR) AS PROGRM_SUM FROM SDA100 A JOIN SEB510 B ON A.RESRCE_NO = B.RESRCE_NO JOIN SEB100 C ON C.CASE_MNG_NO = B.CASE_MNG_NO JOIN SDA300 D ON D.RESRCE_NO = B.RESRCE_NO JOIN SEA200 E ON E.TRPR_INFO_NO = C.TRPR_INFO_NO WHERE E.TRPR_INFO_NO = #{TRPR_INFO_NO} AND D.DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' GROUP BY PVSN_RESRCE_NM, PVSN_BGNG_YMD, PVSN_END_YMD, PTCPTN_NOPE, UTZTN_PSNCPA_NOPE

/* 상세 - 자격정보*/ SELECT T3.QLFC_INFO_MNG_NO AS QLFC_INFO_MNG_NO /* 자격정보관리번호 */ , T3.QLFC_INFO_SN AS QLFC_INFO_SN /* 자격정보일련번호 */ ,(SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'OFAP_PRVATE_QLFC_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T3.OFAP_PRVATE_QLFC_SE_CD) AS OFAP_PRVATE_QLFC_SE_CD /* 공인민간자격구분코드 */ ,(SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'CERTI_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T3.CERTI_SE_CD ) AS CERTI_SE_CD /* 자격증구분코드 */ ,(SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'QLFC_GRAD_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T3.QLFC_GRAD_SE_CD ) AS QLFC_GRAD_SE_CD /* 자격등급구분코드 */ , T3.CERTI_NM AS CERTI_NM /* 자격증명 */ , T3.CERTI_NO AS CERTI_NO /* 자격증번호 */ , T3.ACQS_YMD AS ACQS_YMD /* 취득일자 */ , T3.QLFC_EXPRY_YMD AS QLFC_EXPRY_YMD /* 자격만료일자 */ , T3.PBLCN_INST_NM AS PBLCN_INST_NM /* 발행기관명 */ , T3.RM_CN AS RM_CN /* 비고내용 */ , T3.ATFINO AS ATFINO /* 첨부파일번호 */ , T3.DEL_YN AS DEL_YN /* 삭제여부 */ FROM SEB100 T1 JOIN SEA200 T2 ON T2.TRPR_INFO_NO = T1.TRPR_INFO_NO JOIN SCA111 T3 ON T3.QLFC_INFO_MNG_NO = T2.QLFC_INFO_MNG_NO WHERE T1.CASE_MNG_NO = #{CASE_MNG_NO} AND T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO} AND T3.DEL_YN != 'Y'

/* 상세 - 취업정보 */ SELECT T3.TRPR_INFO_NO AS TRPR_INFO_NO /* 대상자정보번호 */ ,T3.MNG_SN AS MNG_SN /* 관리일련번호 */ ,T3.JNCMP_YMD AS JNCMP_YMD /* 입사일자 */ ,T3.RETIRE_YMD AS RETIRE_YMD /* 퇴사일자 */ ,(SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'EMPYMN_ERA_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T3.EMPYMN_ERA_SE_CD) AS EMPYMN_ERA_SE_CD /* 취업시기구분코드 */ ,(SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'EMPYMN_TYPE_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T3.EMPYMN_TYPE_SE_CD) AS EMPYMN_TYPE_SE_CD /* 근무형태구분코드 */ , T3.CO_NM AS CO_NM /* 회사명 */ , T3.SGG_CD AS SGG_CD /* 시군구코드 */ ,(SELECT CTPV_NM||' '||SGG_NM FROM SAA020 WHERE SGG_CD=T3.SGG_CD) AS SGG_NM /* 시군구명 */ , TO_CHAR(T3.SALARY_AMT, 'FM999,999,999,999') AS SALARY_AMT /* 급여금액 */ , T3.TKCG_TASKWK_CN AS TKCG_TASKWK_CN /* 담당업무내용 */ , T3.RETIRE_CS_CN AS RETIRE_CS_CN /* 퇴사사유내용 */ , T3.RM_CN AS RM_CN /* 비고내용 */ , T3.ATFINO AS ATFINO /* 첨부파일번호 */ FROM SEB100 T1 JOIN SEA200 T2 ON T2.TRPR_INFO_NO = T1.TRPR_INFO_NO JOIN SEA250 T3 ON T3.TRPR_INFO_NO = T2.TRPR_INFO_NO WHERE T1.CASE_MNG_NO = #{CASE_MNG_NO} AND T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO} AND T3.DEL_YN != 'Y'

/* 상세 - 학위취득정보 */ SELECT T3.TRPR_INFO_NO AS TRPR_INFO_NO /* 대상자정보번호 */ , T3.MNG_SN AS MNG_SN /* 관리일련번호 */ , T3.DGRI_ACQS_ERA_YM AS DGRI_ACQS_ERA_YM /* 학위취득시기연월 */ , T3.MTCLTN_YMD AS MTCLTN_YMD /* 입학일자 */ , T3.GRDTN_YMD AS GRDTN_YMD /* 졸업일자 */ , T3.SCHL_NM AS SCHL_NM /* 학교명 */ ,(SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'DGRI_ACQS_MTHD_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T3.DGRI_ACQS_MTHD_SE_CD ) AS DGRI_ACQS_MTHD_SE_CD /* 학위취득방법구분코드 */ ,(SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'ACBG_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T3.ACBG_SE_CD ) AS ACBG_SE_CD /* 학위=학력구분코드 */ , T3.SGG_CD AS SGG_CD /* 시군구코드 */ , (SELECT CTPV_NM || ' ' || SGG_NM FROM SAA020 WHERE SGG_CD= T3.SGG_CD) AS SGG_NM /* 시군구명 */ , T3.MAJOR_NM AS MAJOR_NM /* 전공명 */ ,(SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T3.GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD ) AS GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD /* 재학여부/졸업상태구분코드 */ ,(SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'GRADE_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T3.GRADE_SE_CD ) AS GRADE_SE_CD /* 학년구분코드 */ , T3.STCLS_NO AS STCLS_NO /* 학급번호 */ , T3.SCHULW_DSCNTC_YN AS SCHULW_DSCNTC_YN /* 학업중단여부 */ , T3.RM_CN AS RM_CN /* 비고내용 */ , T3.DEL_YN AS DEL_YN /* 삭제여부 */ FROM SEB100 T1 JOIN SEA200 T2 ON T2.TRPR_INFO_NO = T1.TRPR_INFO_NO JOIN SEA230 T3 ON T3.TRPR_INFO_NO = T2.TRPR_INFO_NO WHERE T1.CASE_MNG_NO = #{CASE_MNG_NO} AND T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO} AND T3.DEL_YN != 'Y'

/* 상세 - 최종학력 */ SELECT SCHL_NM, GRADE_SE_CD, GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD, ACBG_SE_CD FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.TRPR_INFO_NO ORDER BY E.SRTNG_SQNCE DESC, D.SRTNG_SQNCE DESC) ROW_NO, B.SCHL_NM AS SCHL_NM , C.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS GRADE_SE_CD , D.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD , E.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS ACBG_SE_CD FROM SEB100 A JOIN SEA230 B ON A.TRPR_INFO_NO = B.TRPR_INFO_NO LEFT JOIN SAC100 C ON C.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'GRADE_SE_CD' AND C.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = B.GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD LEFT JOIN SAC100 D ON D.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD' AND D.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = B.GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD LEFT JOIN SAC100 E ON E.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'ACBG_SE_CD' AND E.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = B.ACBG_SE_CD WHERE A.CASE_MNG_NO = #{CASE_MNG_NO} AND A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO} AND B.DEL_YN != 'Y' ) A WHERE ROW_NO = 1

/* SQL ID : isry.aimns.attendmgmt.trpr.mapper.TrprMapper - selectTrprHstrList [대상자이력] */ /* Lee Sanghoon */ SELECT A.* , B.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS TRMN_CS -- 종결사유 - 중도탈락사유 , CASE A.QLFC_CNT WHEN 0 THEN 'X' ELSE 'Y' END AS QLFC_YN -- 자격증취득여부 FROM (SELECT -- 사업연도,기관 T6.BIZ_YR -- 사업연도 , T7.INST_NM -- 기관명
-- 교육생 , T4.PVSN_RESRCE_NM -- 제공자원명 , DEC_B64(NVL(T8.FLNM_ENCPT, T1.TRPR_NM_ENCPT)) AS TRPR_NM_ENCPT -- 대상자명암호화 , DEC_B64(T8.RRNO_ENCPT) AS RRNO_ENCPT -- 주민등록번호암호화 , DEC_B64(NVL(T8.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT, T1.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT)) AS MBL_TELNO_ENCPT -- 휴대전화번호암호화
-- 중도탈락 , T9.TRMN_CS_SE_CD -- 종결사유구분코드 , T2.CASE_TRMN_YMD -- 사례종결일자
-- 취업 , T10.CO_NM -- 회사명 , T11.CTPV_NM || ' ' || T11.SGG_NM AS CTPV_SGG_NM -- 시도시군구명 , T10.TKCG_TASKWK_CN -- 담당업무내용 , T10.SALARY_AMT -- 급여금액 , T10.RM_CN -- 비고내용
-- 자격증 , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SEA260 WHERE TRPR_INFO_NO = T1.TRPR_INFO_NO AND ACQS_YMD > T4.PVSN_BGNG_YMD) AS QLFC_CNT -- 자격증갯수
, T4.RESRCE_NO -- 자원번호 , T2.CASE_MNG_NO -- 사례관리번호 , T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO -- 사례관리차수 , T1.TRPR_INFO_NO -- 대상자정보번호
FROM SEA200 T1 /* 대상자정보 */ JOIN SEB100 T2 /* 사례기본 */ ON T2.TRPR_INFO_NO = T1.TRPR_INFO_NO LEFT JOIN (SELECT A.CASE_MNG_NO , A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO , B.RESRCE_NO FROM SEB510 A JOIN SEB500 B ON A.SRVC_PVSN_NO = B.SRVC_PVSN_NO AND A.RESRCE_NO = B.RESRCE_NO WHERE A.DEL_YN != 'Y' AND B. DEL_YN != 'Y') T3 /* 서비스제공대상자 */ ON T3.CASE_MNG_NO = T2.CASE_MNG_NO AND T3.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO LEFT JOIN SDA100 T4 /* 자원기본 */ ON T4.RESRCE_NO = T3.RESRCE_NO LEFT JOIN SDA420 T5 /* 서비스실행사업 */ ON T5.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = T4.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO LEFT JOIN SDA400 T6 /* 서비스사업 */ ON T6.SRVC_BIZ_NO = T5.SRVC_BIZ_NO LEFT JOIN SAA000 T7 /* 통합기관 */ ON T7.INST_NO = T4.RSFR_INST_NO LEFT JOIN SCA300 T8 /* 개인정보 */ ON T8.INDV_IDNTFC_NO = T1.INDV_IDNTFC_NO LEFT JOIN (SELECT B.* , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY B.CASE_MNG_NO, B.CASE_MNG_ODRNO ORDER BY B.CASE_TRMN_NO DESC) AS RN FROM SEC100 A LEFT JOIN SEC100 B ON B.CASE_MNG_NO = A.CASE_MNG_NO AND B.CASE_MNG_NO = A.CASE_MNG_NO AND B.TRMN_SRNG_RESULT_SE_CD = '01' WHERE A.TRMN_SRNG_RESULT_SE_CD = '02' ) T9 ON T9.CASE_MNG_NO = T2.CASE_MNG_NO AND T9.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND T9.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT A.* , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.TRPR_INFO_NO ORDER BY A.MNG_SN DESC) AS RN FROM SEA250 A) T10 /*취업정보*/ ON T10.TRPR_INFO_NO = T1.TRPR_INFO_NO AND T10.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN SAA020 T11 /* 시군구코드 */ ON T11.SGG_CD = T10.SGG_CD
WHERE 1=1 AND T2.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD}
-- 검색조건 : 이름 AND (T1.TRPR_NM_ENCPT = ENC_B64(#{SRCH_VALUE}) OR T8.FLNM_ENCPT = ENC_B64(#{SRCH_VALUE}) )
-- 검색조건 : 전화번호 AND (T1.TRPR_TELNO = #{SRCH_VALUE} OR T1.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT = ENC_B64(#{SRCH_VALUE}) OR T8.WRD_TELNO = #{SRCH_VALUE} OR T8.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT = ENC_B64(#{SRCH_VALUE}) )
-- 검색조건 : 주민번호 AND T8.RRNO_ENCPT = ENC_B64(#{SRCH_VALUE})
AND T4.SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_CD != '01' AND T4.APRV_STTS_SE_CD = '2'
) A LEFT JOIN SAC100 B /* 공통코드값 - 종결사유구분코드 */ ON B.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'TRMN_CS_SE_CD' AND B.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = A.TRMN_CS_SE_CD
